ne2d0622bb7d.s: Who conferred the title 'Raja' on Rammohan Roy and sent him to England as his envoy?
ne2d0622bb7d.x: The Mughal emperor Akbar II gave Rammohan Roy the title 'Raja' and sent him to England as his envoy.

n8839881fe59.s: Rammohan Roy's Tuhfat-ul-Muwahhidin, written against idolatry, was in which language?
n8839881fe59.x: Tuhfat-ul-Muwahhidin ('A Gift to Monotheists') was a Persian work by Rammohan Roy against idolatry.

nbb6e286fefb.s: After the 1866 split of the Brahmo Samaj, Debendranath Tagore's body came to be known as:
nbb6e286fefb.x: After the 1866 split Debendranath Tagore's body became the Adi Brahmo Samaj, while Keshab Chandra Sen led the Brahmo Samaj of India.

nindian-history-120-13.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-history-120-13.x: Jyotiba Phule founded the Satyashodhak Samaj; Rammohan Roy founded the Brahmo Samaj, Dayanand the Arya Samaj and Vivekananda the Ramakrishna Mission.

nee0576c3ca0.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nee0576c3ca0.x: The Ramakrishna Mission was founded in 1897; the Brahmo Samaj dates from 1828, Prarthana Samaj from 1867 and Satyashodhak Samaj from 1873.

nindian-history-51-70.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Swami Vivekananda addressed the Parliament of Religions at Chicago in 1893.
2. Swami Vivekananda founded the Ramakrishna Mission in 1897.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
nindian-history-51-70.x: Both are correct: Vivekananda spoke at Chicago in 1893 and founded the Ramakrishna Mission in 1897.

nindian-history-95-2.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Prarthana Samaj – Founded by M.G. Ranade in 1887
Brahmo Samaj – Founded at Bombay in 1867
Arya Samaj – Revival and reform based on the Vedas
Indian National Social Conference – Founded by Rammohan Roy in 1828
nindian-history-95-2.x: The Arya Samaj sought revival and reform based on the Vedas. Prarthana Samaj was founded at Bombay in 1867, Ranade started the Social Conference in 1887, and Rammohan Roy founded the Brahmo Samaj in 1828.

ndc0ebdb0cbe.s:
Consider the following statements about the Arya Samaj:
1. It rejected idol worship and ritualism.
2. It was founded as a secret organisation.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
ndc0ebdb0cbe.x: The Arya Samaj rejected idol worship and ritualism; a secret character belonged to the Paramahansa Mandali, not the Arya Samaj.

n85ab8b94128.s: Dayananda Saraswati, who wrote his main work in it, promoted which language as a link language?
n85ab8b94128.x: Dayananda wrote his main work in Hindi and promoted Hindi as a link language.

nf19d502185d.s:
Consider the following statements about the work of the Ramakrishna Mission:
1. It has a monastic order devoted to renunciation and practical spirituality.
2. Lay disciples carry on preaching and humanitarian work.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
nf19d502185d.x: The Mission combines a monastic order devoted to renunciation and practical spirituality with lay work in preaching, philanthropy and humanitarian service.

n97db8645dfd.s: In which year did Annie Besant become President of the Theosophical Society?
n97db8645dfd.x: Annie Besant came to India in 1893 and became President of the Theosophical Society in 1907 after Olcott's death.

n1964897461c.s: The Theosophical Society was founded in 1875 at:
n1964897461c.x: Blavatsky and Olcott founded the Theosophical Society at New York in 1875.

n7b854b9eb37.s: Udbodhan, a journal of the Ramakrishna movement, was published in:
n7b854b9eb37.x: Udbodhan was a Bengali journal, while Prabuddha Bharata was in English.

ncbb67836389.s: Who was the first Principal of the Besant Theosophical College, founded at Madanapalle in 1916?
ncbb67836389.x: Annie Besant founded the Besant Theosophical College at Madanapalle in 1916, and H.J. Cousins was its first Principal.

nd04a1f10058.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nd04a1f10058.x: MAO College, Aligarh dates from 1877; the Arya Samaj was founded in 1875, Prarthana Samaj in 1867 and SNDP Yogam in 1903.

na002fa98409.s: In Andhra Pradesh, Madanapalle is identified as a centre of:
na002fa98409.x: Madanapalle is identified as an Andhra centre of Theosophy.

nindian-history-116-13.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-history-116-13.x: The Dev Samaj was at Lahore; the Brahmo Samaj was at Calcutta, the Prarthana Samaj at Bombay and Nadwah-ul-Ulama at Lucknow.

ne406711d78e.s: The chief centre of the anti-British Wahabi movement in India was:
ne406711d78e.x: Syed Ahmad Barelvi's Wahabi movement was anti-British and its chief centre was Patna; Faridpur was the Faraizi base.

n96a975b9e24.s: In 1888 the Deoband leadership issued a fatwa against:
o: Sayyid Ahmad Khan's United Indian Patriotic Association
n96a975b9e24.x: Deoband welcomed the Congress and in 1888 issued a fatwa against Sayyid Ahmad Khan's United Indian Patriotic Association and MAO Association.

neea5e333b13.s: Osmania University, established at Hyderabad in 1918, taught through which language?
neea5e333b13.x: Osmania University was established at Hyderabad in 1918 and taught in Urdu.

n79fc4c36133.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Singh Sabha – Gurmukhi and Punjabi literature
n79fc4c36133.x: The Singh Sabha promoted Gurmukhi and Punjabi literature; Nirankari was linked to Baba Dayal Das, Namdhari to Baba Ram Singh, and the Akalis to removing corrupt mahants.

n7e2a3830096.s: Who is noted as the first to use non-cooperation and boycott of British goods?
n7e2a3830096.x: Ram Singh Kuka is noted as the first to use non-cooperation and boycott of British goods; he was exiled to Rangoon after the 1872 Malerkotla clash.

nce58b018783.s:
Consider the following statements about the Nirankari movement:
1. It promoted idol worship and Brahmin-led rituals.
2. It issued hukamnamas on correct practice and kept its own worship places and priests.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
nce58b018783.x: The Nirankari movement issued hukamnamas on correct practice and developed its own network of worship places and priests; it did not promote idol worship.

n4b0952d9601.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Namdhari followers wore white and carried a lathi.
2. Nirankari teaching centred on worship of the formless God.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
n4b0952d9601.x: Both are correct: Namdharis wore white and carried a lathi, while Nirankari teaching centred on the formless God (Nirankar).

nc6ddb2dec58.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Shetkaryacha Asud – Society of Truth Seekers
nc6ddb2dec58.x: Gulamgiri means Slavery; Satyashodhak Samaj means Society of Truth Seekers and Shetkaryacha Asud means The Cultivator's Whipcord.

nindian-history-22-10.s: Jyotiba Phule's 1873 book comparing caste oppression with slavery is:
nindian-history-22-10.x: Gulamgiri (1873) compared caste oppression with slavery; Sarvajanik Satyadharma Pustak was published posthumously in 1891.

n248cd622ef4.s: The Communal Government Order of 1921 in Madras Presidency gave proportional representation in jobs and education to:
n248cd622ef4.x: The 1921 Communal G.O. provided proportional representation for non-Brahmins in government jobs and education.

n0ba9a4a4473.s: The lasting Andhra legacy of the Justice Party was the establishment, in 1926, of:
n0ba9a4a4473.x: Andhra University, established in 1926, is identified as the Justice Party's lasting Andhra legacy.

nf2e5f48f245.s: K.V. Reddy Naidu of Eluru, a minister in the first Justice ministry of 1920, became Premier in:
nf2e5f48f245.x: Kurma Venkata Reddy Naidu was a minister in the first Justice ministry (1920) and became Premier in 1937.

n53e2f478127.s: Which Madiga leader worked for land rights and seats in local bodies?
n53e2f478127.x: Arige Ramaswamy, a Madiga leader, worked for land rights and representation in local bodies.

naa8deba5ea7.s:
Arrange Ambedkar's organisations and movement in chronological order:
A. Independent Labour Party
B. Bahishkrit Hitakarini Sabha
C. Scheduled Castes Federation
D. Kalaram Temple Satyagraha
naa8deba5ea7.x: Bahishkrit Hitakarini Sabha (1924), Kalaram Temple Satyagraha (1930), Independent Labour Party (1936), Scheduled Castes Federation (1942).

nc782e3c2327.s: The term 'Adi-Hindu' referred to the Dalits of:
nc782e3c2327.x: Adi-Hindu referred to Dalits of Hyderabad State, while Adi-Andhra referred to Dalits of the Andhra region, including coastal Andhra and Rayalaseema.

n2b56bbeabac.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
n2b56bbeabac.x: The Mahar movement belonged to Maharashtra; SNDP was in Kerala, the Self-Respect Movement in Tamil Nadu and the Satnami movement in Chhattisgarh/Central India.

nap-history-15-7.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nap-history-15-7.x: Satihita Bodhini began in 1883; Vivekavardhini dates from 1874, Satyasamvardhini from 1891 and Andhra Geeta Svarajya from 1921.

nap-history-16-15.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Bala Bharathi Samiti – Kokkonda Venkata Ratnam
Madras Native Association – Gajula Lakshminarasu Chetty
nap-history-16-15.x: Gajula Lakshminarasu Chetty founded the Madras Native Association; the youth of Rajahmundry formed the Bala Bharathi Samiti, Kokkonda ran Hasyavardhani and Veeresalingam started Viveka Vardhini.

nf1bbd939953.s: Who, as editor of Andhra Bhasha Sanjeevini, led orthodox opposition to spoken Telugu prose?
nf1bbd939953.x: Kokkonda Venkataratnam, the orthodox editor of Andhra Bhasha Sanjeevini, opposed the move towards spoken Telugu.

nf144b6c3b0f.s: Who wrote Kasiyatra Charitra, an important early modern Telugu travelogue?
nf144b6c3b0f.x: Kasiyatra Charitra was written by Enugula Veeraswamayya.

n18234bfedda.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Raghupathi Venkataratnam Naidu – Brahmo Samaj, Machilipatnam (1882)
Tayi Surya Prakasarao Naidu – Guntur Samaj (1898)
n18234bfedda.x: Raghupathi Venkataratnam Naidu founded the Machilipatnam Brahmo Samaj in 1882; Tayi Surya Prakasarao Naidu founded the Kakinada Samaj and Pillarisetty Sitaramayya the Guntur Samaj.

nap-history-15-14.s: The Nilagiri journal was published from:
nap-history-15-14.x: Nilagiri, started by Shabnavis Venkata Rama Narasimha Rao, was published from Nalgonda in Telangana.

nap-history-16-13.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nap-history-16-13.x: Mutnuri Krishna Rao edited Krishna Patrika; Veeresalingam started Viveka Vardhini, Kasinathuni Nageswara Rao founded Andhra Patrika and Kokkonda ran Hasyavardhani.

n87c4aa099f1.s: The Brahmo Trinity of Andhra comprised Veeresalingam, Raghupathi Venkataratnam Naidu and:
n87c4aa099f1.x: The Brahmo Trinity of Andhra was Veeresalingam, Raghupathi Venkataratnam Naidu and Desiraju Peda Bapaiah.

n981271ff3b8.s: Which of the following is a work of Gidugu Ramamurthy?
o: A Memorandum of Modern Telugu Prose
n981271ff3b8.x: A Memorandum of Modern Telugu Prose is Gidugu's work; Andhra Bhasha Sanjeevini was Kokkonda's journal, Desabhakti is linked with Gurajada and Rajasekhara Charitra with Veeresalingam.

nap-history-23-2-2.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: First widow remarriage in Andhra (1881) – Brahma Naidu
nap-history-23-2-2.x: Raghupathi Venkataratnam Naidu led the anti-nautch campaign; Veeresalingam performed the first widow remarriage (1881), Brahma Naidu founded the Dasa Samaj and the English built Fort St. George.

n143f4895c74.s: Who first rendered Kalidasa's Shakuntalam and Malavikagnimitram into Telugu?
n143f4895c74.x: Kandukuri Veeresalingam was the first to render Kalidasa's Shakuntalam and Malavikagnimitram into Telugu.

ne2600b834d1.s: Which city, Veeresalingam's reform base, has been a cultural capital since Eastern Chalukya times?
ne2600b834d1.x: Rajahmundry was Veeresalingam's reform base and has been regarded as a cultural capital since the Eastern Chalukya period.

n8343f3f0bf2.s: The principal kshetra of Goddess Vasavi is located at:
n8343f3f0bf2.x: Penugonda is the principal kshetra of Goddess Vasavi.

nb2925fbc27c.s: Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar's Barnaparichay was a:
nb2925fbc27c.x: Barnaparichay was a Bengali alphabet primer written by Vidyasagar.

nc64bd080671.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Pandita Ramabai – Girls' school for untouchables
Jyotiba and Savitribai Phule – Arya Mahila Samaj
nc64bd080671.x: D.K. Karve founded the Widow Marriage Association; Pandita Ramabai founded the Arya Mahila Samaj and the Phules set up a girls' school for untouchables.

nindian-history-14-35.shape: one-liner (attribute grid has no four pairs)
nindian-history-14-35.s: D.K. Karve's Home for Widows at Hingne near Poona was established in:
nindian-history-14-35.x: Karve set up his Home for Widows near Poona in 1896; in 1916 he founded the first Women's University, now SNDT University, Bombay.

n2686e4aa184.s: 'The Cry of Mother India', regarded as the first nationalist song in Andhra, appeared in 1905 in:
n2686e4aa184.x: 'The Cry of Mother India' appeared in Krishna Patrika on 15 December 1905.

n399c4646930.s: The Indian National Conference, held in 1883 and 1885 and later merged with the INC, was convened by:
n399c4646930.x: Surendranath Banerjee convened the Indian National Conference in 1883 and 1885; it later merged with the INC.

nfe12c6fef48.s:
Consider the following statements about the early Indian National Congress:
1. It provided the first all-India political platform.
2. It was initially a mass peasant organisation with a rural membership.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
nfe12c6fef48.x: The early INC was the first all-India political platform, but its base was narrow, urban and educated, not rural peasant.

nea7242a5100.s: A.O. Hume, closer to the Bombay and Poona groups than to the Calcutta leaders, served the INC as its first:
nea7242a5100.x: Hume was closer to the Bombay and Poona groups and served as the first General Secretary of the INC.

nb2bbe763965.s: Lord Dufferin, after initially tolerating the Congress, later dismissed it as representing a:
nb2bbe763965.x: Dufferin first showed official tolerance but later criticised the Congress as representing a 'microscopic minority'.

nfe3218241ba.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Rash Behari Ghosh – Poona 1895 and Ahmedabad 1902
nfe3218241ba.x: Pherozeshah Mehta presided at Calcutta in 1890; Surendranath Banerjee at Poona 1895 and Ahmedabad 1902; Rash Behari Ghosh at Surat 1907 and Madras 1908.

nindian-history-102-25.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-history-102-25.x: The Lucknow Pact was in 1916; Swaraj was adopted in 1906, the Surat Split came in 1907 and the Nehru Report in 1928.

nindian-history-102-12.s: Which of the following pairs (INC President – session) is correctly matched?
nindian-history-102-12.x: Vallabhbhai Patel presided at Karachi in 1931; Motilal Nehru at Calcutta 1928, Jawaharlal Nehru at Lahore 1929 and Bose at Haripura 1938.

nindian-history-103-24.s: After the 1922 Gaya session of the INC rejected council entry, C.R. Das and Motilal Nehru formed the:
nindian-history-103-24.x: The Gaya session (1922) rejected council entry, after which C.R. Das and Motilal Nehru formed the Swaraj Party.

nindian-history-111-13.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-history-111-13.x: The Nehru Report came in 1928; the Congress–League pact was in 1916, the Purna Swaraj Resolution in 1929 and Purna Swaraj Day on 26 January 1930.
